identity.label: Character persona creation
identity.summary: Persona-building skill for AI roleplay characters, writing concise first-page self-perception that separates character belief from author knowledge and preserves organic emotional discovery.

source_links: AGENTS.md: Character Persona Creation for AI Roleplay

memory_routing: Store persona lines in Character Book only when they reflect what the character could plausibly believe or say early.
Keep hidden truths, future development, and author-only analysis outside the persona surface unless routed to private author notes.

guardrails: Do not include external analysis, meta-commentary, or future emotional conclusions in the persona.
Do not short-circuit roleplay discovery by revealing hidden truths too early.
All persona content must fit character self-awareness and voice.
